errors.text_span: For each category on the x-axis, two stacked bars are shown:
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart shows one bar per category. Furthermore, the bar for the "Base" category is a single, non-stacked bar, while the other two categories have stacked bars.

errors.text_span: The chart indicates that the "Ours" method consistently outperforms the "Standard" method across all three configurations.
errors.evidence: This comparison cannot be made for the "Base" configuration because there is no "Standard" bar shown for that category. Therefore, stating that "Ours" outperforms "Standard" across all three configurations is an interpretation, not a direct reading of the chart.
